rulings.restated: Input — The qualified business loss carryforward from line 16 of your 2024 Form 8995 (or the corresponding line of your 2024 Form 8995-A), entered as a positive amount (zero if none)
rulings.model: IRS line 3 is "Qualified business net (loss) carryforward from the prior year" shown with parentheses, and line 4 says "Combine lines 2 and 3," so the carryforward is a negative amount; the restatement instead says "entered as a positive amount." The line 3 instructions also require the "qualified portion" allowed in calculating taxable income in the current year, not merely prior-year line 16.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; on the sign: f8995 p. 1, line 3 "Qualified business net (loss) carryforward from the prior year" is printed in parentheses and line 4 says "Combine lines 2 and 3". The qbi line 3 is an input entered as a positive amount, and the form line that prints it negates it (f8995.line3: "Subtract qbi line 3 from qbi helper 'Year parameter sales.zero'"), so lines 4 and 16 combine a negative amount as the form requires; the model read the input's sign convention as the printed amount. On the second point (the "qualified portion" allowed this year, i8995 p. 4, Line 3: "Include here the qualified portion of trade or business (loss) carryforward allowed in calculating taxable income in the current year"; i8995 p. 3: previously suspended losses allowed are "treated as a qualified net loss carryforward ... See Line 3"): scope, refused by qbi.unsupported ("losses or deductions suspended in an earlier year by another provision and allowed this year") on qbi.eligible. Incidental citation-only finding on this line: findings.md F2.
